# Chefekonomen om valrysare – AI-skräck sänker börsen

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The EFN Morgon episode from 14 September 2026 covers a weak market open. It was driven by fears about AI safety after a whistleblower claimed there was a 10% risk of human extinction, and OpenAI and Anthropic have backed parts of that claim. Brent oil at $107 and a US 10-year yield near 5% ahead of this week's Fed decision add to the pressure. Nordea's chief economist Annika Winsth says the close Swedish election and messy government formation matter little for the economy or markets compared with global factors. Company news includes weak August sales from Hemnet, an early CEO change at Munters, Carnegie's sell-off of Asker, and analyst upgrades for Telia and Axfood.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NKE — Nike | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host Martin Blomgren holds Nike as a 'joker' in his own global portfolio and says it has become very cheap.

#### Reasoning

This is host opinion. Martin likes Nike and says it has become very cheap, which is a valuation argument. He picked it as a bottom-fishing joker in a DIY global index portfolio, so it is a long-term position. He stresses that the method matters more than the exact picks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation re-rates without a turnaround
- if brand weakness persists

> *"Jag gillar ju såklart Nike. Där kan vi verkligen prata om ett bolag som har blivit väldigt billigt."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A 'star' holding in the host's DIY global index portfolio.

#### Reasoning

This is host opinion. Nvidia is included as one of the large companies that are big because they execute well. It is a core index-replication holding, not a high-conviction call, and the episode's AI fears are a near-term headwind.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI regulation slows the pace of development
- if AI IPO risk spreads to valuations

> *"andra AI-spelare som Nvidia, Microsoft, TSMC"*

---

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A 'star' holding in the host's DIY global index portfolio.

#### Reasoning

This is host opinion. Microsoft is a core holding among the top global stars used to replicate a global index. The episode's AI-safety worries are a near-term risk to it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if OpenAI IPO or AI regulation shocks hit AI valuations

> *"andra AI-spelare som Nvidia, Microsoft, TSMC"*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A 'star' holding in the host's DIY global index portfolio.

#### Reasoning

This is host opinion. TSMC is a core AI-infrastructure holding in the global portfolio. Asian semiconductors are under pressure today from the AI fears.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex slows because of regulation

> *"andra AI-spelare som Nvidia, Microsoft, TSMC"*

---

### 🟢 AXFO — Axfood | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken upgraded Axfood to buy and the stock rose 2.6%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view from Handelsbanken, not the hosts. The Nordea economist expects the food VAT cut to be reversed, which could be a risk for grocers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the food VAT cut is reversed and hurts volumes
- if the analyst's upgrade thesis fails

> *"Handelsbanken har höjt Axfood till köp"*

---

### 🟡 TELIA — Telia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Analyst upgraded Telia to hold from sell and the stock rose.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst upgrade from sell to hold, and the stock rose on it. The episode does not name the broker.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the analyst cuts the rating back to sell

> *"Telia har fått en behållrekommendation från tidigare än säljrekommendation"*

---

### 🔴 ASKER — Asker | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Carnegie moved from buy to sell after questioning earnings quality and valuation. The stock fell about 19% and rebounded 3% today.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited Carnegie analyst view. Two analysts questioned accounting and earnings quality and how the company should be valued. The hosts note the debate over serial-acquirer multiples may spread to peers. Asker has partly rebounded.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Carnegie's concerns are refuted by reported cash flow
- if earnings quality proves solid

> *"Mycket från köp till sälj."*

---

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

August sales fell 24% and the CEO called the month subdued. Buybacks were paused after board and management changes.

#### Reasoning

The hosts are cautious. They say the sales figures look subdued, but the new 'sell first, pay later' model shifts revenue timing, so the numbers need adjusting. The reaction was mild and follows last week's fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if housing activity keeps weakening
- if the new management changes strategy negatively

> *"vd säger att det har varit en väldigt dämpad augusti"*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 8-9% on the AI fears. It is strongly linked to the US and seen as a tech proxy.

#### Reasoning

This is the hosts' observation of short-term momentum and risk. Sivers is the Swedish proxy for the AI/tech sell-off after the AI-safety statements and uncertainty over the OpenAI and Anthropic IPOs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI fear subsides and US tech recovers

> *"skulle Sivers vara någon slags proxy på hur det ser ut i tech så är den ytterligare ner nu nästan 9 %"*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO took over early and management was reshuffled. The stock is down 2-3%, possibly because of its AI data-center exposure.

#### Reasoning

The hosts are split. The early handover could mean the succession is ahead of plan, but it also raises questions about why a planned change was moved. The stock is also exposed to AI data-center sentiment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next report shows weakness
- if the data-center demand outlook worsens

> *"Jag tror inte man ska vara för konspiratorisk, men visst, det väcker lite frågor."*
